name: Luke Randolph
source:
Luke is the youngest of the princes, but his height reminds people of a bear. He's a bit on the lazy side, and also charming and loveable, but there are times when a shadow crosses over his eyes, and you don't know why... 

"Nah, I don't feel like working. Let's leave the rest to them and go have fun." 

[From in-game profile]
